: Three enrichment runs with deliberately different thresholds. Conflating them is the easiest way to misread the app. {tbl-colwidths="auto"}

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
The permissive 0.2/0.2 regime is an exploratory screen over small per-subcluster lists; the 0.05/0.2 regime is what the contrast-specific results and the collaborator deliverable use.
:::
